title: Add Sparkle Studio to image
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [Sparkle Studio](https://sparkle-studio-pollinations-a031.onbelmo.uk) to image
- Draw jewelry, then make it sparkle. A playful web app for kids: sketch a piece of jewelry (or just describe it), and an AI turns it into a polished, photorealistic render. Powered entirely by Pollinat

Fixes #12863

gist.headline: Jewels, but make them sparkle
gist.blurb: Sparkle Studio joined the garden: draw a jewel, describe a jewel, then let AI give it the shiny treatment. Tiny designers now have a very serious jewelry workshop.
gist.summary: Added Sparkle Studio to the community app directory, a kid-friendly web app that turns jewelry sketches or descriptions into polished photorealistic renders using Pollinations.
gist.impact: People can now discover Sparkle Studio through Pollinations' app listings and turn rough jewelry ideas into sparkling rendered designs.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Sparkle Studio as a cozy tiny jewelry workbench: a child's crayon-like sketch of a necklace becomes a polished sparkling gem render on a retro monitor. Polli wears a miniature jeweler's loupe and carefully dusts glitter over the transformation, surrounded by pastel flowers and code-plants in lime green pots.
gist.image_prompt: A cozy pixel art jewelry workshop where Polli, the cute yellow striped bee mascot with pink blush, light blue wings, and a tiny jeweler's loupe, turns a childlike necklace sketch into a polished sparkling gem on a glowing retro CRT monitor. Lime green (#ecf874) flower pots hold little code-plants beside pastel gems and flowers; cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with subtle pixel-font text reading “SPARKLE STUDIO”.
